lines.t: The time has come and I came
I called you up for safety from pain
The tombs gave up their sleepers, my hand passed through the ground
Flood beach serving right, no child in womb can be found
Now hush, the city wails, the streets cry out in loss and flame
My bride is gathered close so indignation may come to those who remain
Step into the chamber, shut the door, draw curtains tight
Here is my peace, the keeping place, the harbor in the night
I shelter you from thunder, I wrap you in my shade
My hand will walk the valley where the judgments must be made
Hide with me until it passes
Hide with me until refinement is through
Few are called to mercy, the many must be brought through
I go to sift the nations
I go to break their pride
Hide me, my chosen one
Within my house, abide
The earth yields my saints
The whole world gives up its youth
For three days bitter sorrows
And the cries cannot be soothed
I pass through fire and whirlwind to purge the hardened land
So you may rise and mourn and bloom with cleansed and healing hands
Angels climb the ladder hand to hand, they bear the price
From sky to soil I bridge the way, another harvest supplies
We'll be right back.
Once I have tread my day of wrath, I'll call you out again
Thus nations learn the painful truth, all falsehoods fall away
Then hand in hand we walk the garden and greet a gentler day
I have sealed your place
Keep watch, my love, keep rest
Hide with me this week
Trust my ways are bad
Hide with me until it passes
Hide with me until refinement is through
Few are called to mercy
The many must be brought through
I go to set the nations
I go to break their pride
Hide with me, my chosen one
Within my house abide
Thanks for watching!
